keyword: how many back to back masters winners
claims: As of April 12, 2026, only four golfers have won back-to-back Masters tournaments in history.
Rory McIlroy became the fourth player to win back-to-back Masters tournaments.
Jack Nicklaus won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 1965–1966.
Nick Faldo won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 1989–1990.
Tiger Woods won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 2001–2002.
Rory McIlroy won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 2025–2026.
No golfer has ever won three consecutive Masters tournaments.
